input.summary: Play holes 1 through 9 in order, secure the third ball at the Mean Hole when multiball starts, then clear the strobing jackpots for the 300M Super.

quickInfo.name: Nine holes
quickInfo.summary: Complete holes in numerical order; the first and third nine-hole completions start multiball.

quickInfo.name: Third ball
quickInfo.summary: At multiball start, plunge into the Mean Hole to upgrade two-ball play to three balls.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot set
quickInfo.summary: Collect every strobing jackpot shot; the last remaining shot becomes the 300M Super.

quickInfo.name: Captive ball
quickInfo.summary: Captive-ball hits raise the regular jackpot value and end-of-ball bonus.

quickInfo.name: Go-Fore-Par-Tee
quickInfo.summary: Spell G-O-P-H-E-R on the wheel for a three-ball center-lane and Volcano scoring mode.

steps.text: Read the current hole and test its required shot, the Mean Hole, Volcano, center lane, and captive ball.
Complete holes 1 through 9 in order, using the right ramp for holes 2, 4, and 8 and the saucer for 3, 5, and 7.
When the ninth hole starts multiball, plunge the served ball into the Mean Hole to add the third ball.
Collect the currently strobing jackpot shots, choosing the safest available feed first.
When one jackpot remains, treat that shot as the 300M Super and set it up from control.
After the Super, repeat the relit set while ball count permits.
Between nine-hole cycles, build G-O-P-H-E-R only from incidental safe wheel results.

fallback.title: Go-Fore-Par-Tee
fallback.when: Use this when the hole sequence is stalled but G-O-P-H-E-R is nearly complete.

steps.text: Finish the remaining wheel letters.
Start the three-ball mode.
Repeat the center lane or Volcano from the safer current flipper.

alternatives.title: Raining Cats and Dogs
alternatives.when: Use this after the second nine-hole completion.

steps.text: Start the three-ball storm.
Repeat controlled lit jackpot shots and the center lane.
Protect the deferred total from a tilt after the mode.

alternatives.title: Skins certainty
alternatives.when: Use this when Skins is complete and match position does not justify risking the score.

steps.text: Take the guaranteed points instead of double-or-nothing.
If choosing the gamble, identify the selected shot before committing.
Use the Dogleg recovery only if the gamble fails and the feed is safe.
Complete four full nine-hole cycles.
Shoot the Mean Hole when Anything Goes is lit.
Use three-ball play to repeat the lit 50M storm shots.

techniques.name: Mean-Hole third ball
techniques.instruction: At multiball start, prioritize the served plunge into the Mean Hole; missing leaves only two balls in play.

techniques.name: Cradle
techniques.instruction: After clearing the other strobing shots, cradle and set up the final lit shot because it is the 300M Super.

cautions.issue: The center lane is narrow and coconut-target rebounds can drain immediately.
cautions.response: Use multiball protection or a known straight feed for center-lane work.

cautions.issue: Raining Cats and Dogs awards its accumulated total at end of ball.
cautions.response: Reduce nudging and protect the deferred total from a tilt.
